lore.autumnity.redstone_jack_o_lantern: It smiles at you, and will alight with a flux signal.
lore.autumnity.large_redstone_jack_o_lan: A huge pumpkin which smiles at you, and will alight with a flux signal.
lore.autumnity.foul_soup: A Soup cooked in a Cooking Pot with 2 Foul Berries, Spider Eye and Onion.
lore.autumnity.foul_berries: Disgusting on its own, anything eaten afterwards will double in quality.
entity.autumnity.snail.description: A shy shelled creature that hides when you get too close. When fed mushrooms, it secretes Snail Goo. Drops shell pieces when it grows up, and breeds with Mushroom Stew.
